OpenCode Pair
Connect this phone to the OpenCode session on your computer.
Please enter a valid http:// or https:// address.
127.0.0.1 only works on the computer itself. Use the 192.168.x.x link instead, or scan the QR code.
Connect
Scan QR code
Server address or pairing link
Run “opencode pair” on your PC, then scan its QR code or paste one of the three links it prints (192.168.x.x or the https address — not 127.0.0.1). Links work once and expire in 5 minutes.
The address is saved and reopened automatically next time.
